hash_basis:
sha256 of the file with CRLF and lone CR normalised to LF, not of the raw bytes. These CSVs are text and git may hand a checkout either line ending, so a raw-byte digest pins the platform rather than the data: the 1.0 registry's digests were taken over CRLF bytes and would have rejected every dataset on a Linux checkout of the same commit. Recompute with: python -c "import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read().replace(b'
',b'
').replace(b'',b'
')).hexdigest())" <file>. .gitattributes additionally pins benchmark/data/*.csv to LF in the working tree.
